units.source_text: 太吉郎本想让女儿去看看这种伐竹仪式。

en.t: Takichiro had originally wanted to let his daughter go and see this bamboo-cutting ceremony.

units.source_text: 由于天下雨，就有点犹豫不决。

en.t: Because it was raining, he was somewhat hesitant and unable to decide.
